name: Naxos in a day
description_md:
Naxos in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk between the city's main sights. The route covers 10.9 km of walking between stops and takes about 7.0 hours for the full day, visit time at each stop included.

The day is anchored in Naxos, located in GR. This itinerary features six sightseeing stops along the path.
